entities.name: OPRL1
observations: The gene encodes the nociceptin/orphanin FQ receptor; a Japanese study reported an rs2229205 variant association with smoking status.

entities.name: rs2229205
observations: Genotypic and allelic variation was significantly associated with smoking status in Japanese participants; the abstract supplies no direction, effect size, sample size, or p-value.

entities.name: Smoking status
observations: Smoking status was the phenotype associated with OPRL1 rs2229205 in a Japanese study; tested variants were not significantly associated with smoking-related traits.

entities.name: PMID:27491383
observations: Hikida et al., Pharmacogenomics (2016): eight SNPs in opioid receptor-related genes were assessed in Japanese; OPRL1 rs2229205 showed significant genotypic and allelic association with smoking status, but no significant associations with smoking-related traits.
